title: Renames a `Person` object relationship attribute
summary: Renames the relationship[account_opener] field to relationship[representative] on a Person object.

migrationNotes.text: Lets you more accurately and intuitively identify the person who is designated as the representative for an account. By renaming the relationship[account_opener]field to relationship[representative], the terminology better reflects the role and purpose of this person within the account.
